items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Ernest Coycault. They had a band. We used to go down to the beach and play.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's his name. Ernest Coycault. They had a band. We used to go down to the beach and play. And sometimes those rednecks down there didn't want you down there, and they didn't want you down there they'd
just boo you out of the place, you know.
